options.title: Business 107: Organizational Behavior
conditions: Provider-reported conditional match: Study.com lists this exact WGU receiving-course title and competency-unit value, but its program table does not state an applicable catalog or cohort. This is not a WGU-certified articulation.
Obtain WGU adviser approval for this exact Study.com course, WGU Business Management catalog 202605, and your start date before purchase. WGU makes the final credit decision.
The source course carries 3 semester credits; the proposed receiving requirement carries 3 WGU competency units. These are separate credit systems; WGU evaluation decides the award.
Complete all transfer coursework and have official transcripts evaluated before the WGU program starts.
